messages:
olivia_sales: Sierra Health wants a short perf runbook + cost comparison. Requirements: sustained 250 QPS, two 2-minute bursts to 1k QPS, multi-AZ, p99 < 240ms during bursts, customer-managed KMS + audit log export. Need a concise plan before their 9:30am PT sync.

matt_se: Will do. Which model and token sizes?

olivia_sales: They prefer a quantized 7b low-latency variant. Typical request: 70 tokens in, 45 tokens out (~115 tokens total). Mostly chat-style many short requests.

kevin_perf: Suggested phases: 1) baseline smoke (5m at 10 QPS) 2) ramp to 250 QPS over 6m, sustain 15m 3) burst window: 2x (2m at 1k QPS with 8m cool-down) 4) AZ drain/failover verify 5) metrics harvest (p50/p95/p99, GPU util, queue depth).

kevin_perf: Notes: small outputs -> batching benefits but watch head-of-line. Enable KV prefix cache and greedy batching cap ~64 requests to balance throughput vs latency.

nina_network: For multi-AZ tail control recommend 1 pinned replica per AZ plus cross-AZ fallback. VPC peering required?

olivia_sales: They want VPC peering + IP allowlist. KMS mandatory.

sara_security: Security checklist: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, TLS+mutual auth for ingestion, S3 audit export, SOC2 docs. KMS + VPC peering are blockers until done. KMS provisioning ~48-72h, peering ~1 business day.

matt_se: Quick k6 snippet to simulate ramp+burst (replace vars):

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export let options = { stages:[{duration:'6m',target:250},{duration:'15m',target:250},{duration:'2m',target:1000},{duration:'8m',target:0}] };
export default function(){ http.post('__ENDPOINT__', JSON.stringify({model:'q7b-lite',prompt:'...70 tokens...',max_tokens:45}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer __TOKEN__'}}); }
```

kevin_perf: Cost sketch (very rough): avg tokens/request 115. Sustained 250 QPS for 1h -> 250*3600*115 = 103,500,000 tokens. Using hosted placeholder $0.06 / 1k tokens => hosted ~= $6,210 for 1hr. Dedicated reserved node estimate ~ $480/hr (amortized) and gives much cheaper per-token marginal cost and better burst headroom. We'll produce exact calc with model perf numbers.

olivia_sales: Customer also asked: if p99 >240ms during burst, can we fail over to smaller model automatically?

kevin_perf: Yes. Runbook should include a fallback policy: monitor p99 in sliding 3-min windows; if p99>240ms for two consecutive windows during burst, route new sessions to a smaller 3b model and flag ops. We'll include deploy flags and telemetry events.

sara_security: Add note: audit log export must be configured to their S3 and retention SLA 30 days. Also need proof of SOC2 and last pen test summary.

ci-bot: Canary infra prewarm request created: pool=sierra-prewarm-1k, scheduled=2026-06-15T06:30:00Z.

matt_se: Action items: I'll attach k6 scripts + runbook, @kevin_perf full GPU count + cost calc, @sara_security checklist + timelines. Olivia will lead customer sync.

olivia_sales: Thanks all—will present this at 9:30am PT. Short follow-up after sync. :thumbsup:
